task: Audit checker ownership facts for a multi-arm match after package native generation failed closed.
observation: The match fact collector stopped when it reached the first nested arm-body statement because it required the next flattened Stmt to have the immediate Case indentation. A later sibling Case with payloads was therefore omitted even though ordinary checker traversal still processed it.
impact: Consumers correctly rejected the incomplete arm set. Walking the whole match-owned subtree while collecting only immediate Case nodes preserves exact arm authority and allows explicit validation of all arms.

resolution.summary: The checker now continues across nested arm bodies and collects every immediate Case arm. The focused gate verifies case names, payload identities/types, payload access and transfer, and fail-closed fact corruption.
